Author: Dawid
Name: Atelier
Description: Replaces clunky game windows with mouse-and-keyboard windows in the HealFrames skins (Ledger, Heraldry, Signal). Each window is a module you can switch off to get the game's own window back. One click does one thing; nothing runs on its own.
Punchline: PC-first replacements for FFXIV's console-style windows.
Changelog: New windows: Teleport, Collections, Social, Vendor shop, Journal, Achievements & Hunting Log, Party Finder, Market Board. Character: Look tab (dyes, glamour, plates), recommended gear, gearset update/rename/save, reliable equipping. Duty Finder artwork banners.
